main_text.l: ponere, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. שָׁכַן ponere.
שְׁכוֹ [?] sepes sua, No. f. m. שׂוֹךְ, aff. Rad. שׂוּךְ sepivit, vel, pro סְכוֹ tugurium ejus, Rad. סָכַךְ texit.
לְשָׁכְנִי [?] menti, No. f. m. præf. R. שָׁכָה aspicere.
בְּשְׂכּוֹת [?] in tabernaculis, No. pl. f. Rad. שָׁכַךְ vel סָכַךְ texit.
שְׁכִיּוֹת [?] imagines, No. pl. f. à f. fæm. שְׁכִיָּה; Rad. שָׁכָה aspicere.
שָׁכִין [?] culter, (pro שְׂכִים,) No. pl. m. Rad. שָׁכַךְ, vel est No. Rad. f. m. שָׁכִין, qu. à Rad. שָׁכַן.
שָׁכְכָה [?] sedata est, præt. Kal, 3. f. f. R. שָׁכַךְ.
שָׁכְּכָה [?] quod sic, est שׁ præf. cum Part. Adv. כְּ, & parag. כָּכָה.
שָׁכְתִּי [?] sepivisti, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. R. שׂוּךְ.
שָׁכְּתִי [?] sedatus sum, præt. Kal, 1. f. f. Rad. שָׁכַךְ ; vel pro סְכֹתִי [?] obtexi, Rad. סָכַךְ.
שָׁלַל [?] spoliare, Infin. Kal, Rad. שָׁלַל.
שָׁלַחּ [?] extrahe, Imper. Kal, f. m. Rad. נָשַׁל.
הַשָּׁל [?] error, No. f. m. præf. Rad. שָׁלָה tranquillum esse.
שַׁלְּאָנָן [?] tranquillissimus, est No. שַׁאֲנָן, (cum epenth. ל,) à Rad. שַׁאַן; vel est comp. ex No. שָׁלוֹ [?] tranquillus, R. שָׁלָה tranquillum esse, & שַׁאֲנָן tranquillus, Rad. שַׁאַן.
שְׁלַהֶבֶת [?] flamma, eft No. לַהֶבֶת, (cum prothesi ש) unde comp. cum יָהּ Deus, שַׁלְהֶבְתְּיָה [?] flamma Dei, Rad. להב flamma.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and consonants were read at the limit of legibility at this scan resolution; every Hebrew word is marked [?] where I could not confirm it letter by letter. The Latin is clear. The left-margin speck and the Google digitiser mark are not transcribed. The entry "ש ל" is a bare letter heading and is written as a paragraph.
